focus.zh: 电影 IP → 互动 VR

blurb.en: Turns beloved film characters into authored, interactive VR adventures.
blurb.zh: 把熟悉的电影角色变成可参与的 VR 故事。

strength.en: Production, technical development and distribution sit in the same group. Wallace & Gromit was made with Aardman and Meta.
strength.zh: 集团把制作、技术和发行串在一起，与 Aardman、Meta 联合制作《超级无敌掌门狗》VR 冒险。

limit.en: Authored interaction, not evidence of an open-ended AI cast.
limit.zh: 强项是导演设计的互动，不能等同于开放式 AI 角色。

funding.en: €5M round in January 2026, with HTC among the investors.
funding.zh: 2026 年 1 月完成一轮 500 万欧元融资，HTC 参与。

alt.en: Wallace & Gromit: The Grand Getaway — project still
alt.zh: 《超级无敌掌门狗》VR 项目剧照

advantage.en: Brings film IP from production to release.
advantage.zh: 把电影 IP 从互动改编做到发行。

blurb.en: In Fabula Rasa, you talk to characters and they react in real time.
blurb.zh: 《Fabula Rasa》里，观众开口，角色会当场回应。

strength.en: A handcrafted VR world gives improvised conversations a role in the story. The Line offers a contrasting, directed approach.
strength.zh: 在手工设计的 VR 世界里，把角色即兴回应放进叙事。《The Line》则展示了更强导演控制的做法。

limit.en: Live conversation does not establish a world that remembers previous visitors.
limit.zh: 角色能即兴说话，不等于世界会记住此前来过的观众。

funding.en: Founder confirms venture funding; no reliable public amount verified.
funding.zh: 创始人确认拿过风投；未核到可靠的公开金额。

alt.zh: 《Fabula Rasa》场景截图

label.en: Co-founder on ARVORE's first venture round
label.zh: 联合创始人谈首轮融资

advantage.en: Lets characters answer players in their own words.
advantage.zh: 让角色直接回应观众说的话。

blurb.en: Red Coast Echo makes audience choices part of a Chinese sci-fi world.
blurb.zh: 《三体：红岸回响》让观众在中国科幻世界里做选择。

strength.en: Three-Body Universe produced the VR film, made by its studio Dimension Interactive. Audience choices can lead to different endings.
strength.zh: 三体宇宙出品，旗下次元互动制作。观众做出的关键选择可以走向不同结局。

limit.en: The branches are authored. This is not evidence of AI improvising the narrative.
limit.zh: 分支来自事先设计，不等于 AI 即兴写剧情。

funding.en: No verified standalone round amount for Dimension Interactive.
funding.zh: 未核到次元互动可单列的融资金额。

alt.zh: 《红岸回响》电影节海报

image.credit: 三体宇宙 / 北京国际电影节

label.en: Red Coast Echo — Beijing International Film Festival
label.zh: 北京国际电影节：《红岸回响》

label.en: Beijing News: the studio and the award

advantage.en: Turns familiar sci-fi scenes into walkable group experiences.
advantage.zh: 让观众结伴走进熟悉的科幻场景。

focus.zh: VR 先驱 → 生成剧集

blurb.en: Wolves in the Walls makes a viewer part of Lucy's story.
blurb.zh: 《墙里的狼》让观众真正成为 Lucy 故事的一部分。

strength.en: An Emmy-winning example of a character noticing the viewer and building a relationship with them.
strength.zh: 拿过互动媒体 Emmy 的案例：角色注意到观众，并与观众建立关系。

limit.en: Its later Showrunner direction is generated episodic storytelling, not the same as a live VR world.
limit.zh: 后来的 Showrunner 主攻生成式剧集，和实时 VR 空间世界不是一回事。

funding.en: Amazon Alexa Fund invested in 2025; amount undisclosed.
funding.zh: 2025 年获 Amazon Alexa Fund 投资，金额未披露。

alt.en: Wolves in the Walls — official VR artwork
alt.zh: 《墙里的狼》官方 VR 视觉

label.en: Wolves in the Walls — official trailer and project
label.zh: 《墙里的狼》官方预告和项目页
翠贝卡电影节：《墙里的狼》
美国电视学院：2019 Emmy 档案

advantage.en: Builds a relationship through a character’s gaze and gestures.
advantage.zh: 用角色的眼神和动作建立关系。

focus.zh: 多人全身追踪／门店规模化

blurb.en: Turns Squid Game and Deadwood into group experiences with ticket sales.
blurb.zh: 把《鱿鱼游戏》和《Deadwood》做成可售票的组队体验。

strength.en: Full-body tracking, repeatable venue formats and licensed alongside original stories. In October 2026 the company reported about 100 locations and US$300M in lifetime sales.
strength.zh: 把全身追踪、标准化场馆、授权与原创内容串起来。公司 2026 年 10 月披露约 100 个地点、累计销售额达 3 亿美元。

limit.en: The sales figure is not profit or financing. Its strongest public evidence is group play, not intimate, open-ended narrative.
limit.zh: 销售额不等于利润或融资。公开案例更能证明多人玩法，而非开放式作者叙事。

funding.en: US$116M subtotal: US$68M Series A and US$11M strategic funding in 2019; US$37M Series B in 2021. Not lifetime funding.
funding.zh: 三笔公开金额小计 1.16 亿美元：2019 年 A 轮 6800 万、战略轮 1100 万；2021 年 B 轮 3700 万。不是完整累计。

alt.zh: 《Deadwood》三部曲官方宣传图

label.en: Company release: 100 locations and lifetime sales
label.zh: 公司公告：门店与累计销售额

advantage.en: Runs the same tracked group format across many venues.
advantage.zh: 把多人全身追踪做成可跨门店运营的体验。

blurb.en: Horizon of Khufu turns cultural history into a walkable story.
blurb.zh: 《消失的法老》把文化历史变成可以走进去的故事。

strength.en: The Immersive Expeditions format takes free-roaming groups through authored sequences and tours across venues.
strength.zh: Immersive Expeditions 把观众的自由行走放进导演编排的段落，可在多个场馆巡展。

limit.en: Requires space and venue operations; walking freely does not mean the story can branch freely.
limit.zh: 需要场馆和现场运营；能自由走动，不等于剧情能自由分支。

funding.en: €2.9M first round in 2020 from Bpifrance, HTC and ArtNova; not a lifetime total.
funding.zh: 2020 年首轮 290 万欧元，Bpifrance、HTC 与 ArtNova 参与；不是累计融资。

alt.zh: 《消失的法老》预告画面

label.en: IDFA DocLab report: Fabien Barati on the format
label.zh: IDFA DocLab 报告：Fabien Barati 谈大空间体验

advantage.en: Makes historical spaces walkable at group scale.
advantage.zh: 让多人走进历史现场，而不只在原地看。

blurb.en: CultVRe adapts one act of The Nutcracker for Android XR.
blurb.zh: CultVRe 把《胡桃夹子》其中一幕搬进 Android XR。

strength.en: YB collaborates with San Francisco Ballet, Google and XREAL. The published plan sets the full Act I release for December 4, 2026.
strength.zh: 联手旧金山芭蕾舞团、Google 和 XREAL。官方计划于 2026 年 12 月 4 日发布完整第一幕。

limit.en: The case demonstrates immersive viewing and distribution, not AI characters or branching.
limit.zh: 证明的是沉浸观看和分发，不是 AI 角色或剧情分支。

funding.en: US$1.5M pre-Series A in 2021; research grants are separate.
funding.zh: 2021 年 Pre-A 轮 150 万美元；研发补助另计。

alt.en: San Francisco Ballet dancers in The Nutcracker
alt.zh: 旧金山芭蕾舞团《胡桃夹子》剧照

advantage.en: Takes a performance audience onto and behind the stage.
advantage.zh: 把观众带进演出现场，甚至带到舞台后方。

blurb.en: Combines XR production, equipment and venue operation.
blurb.zh: 把 XR 内容、设备和线下场馆放进同一个项目。

strength.en: Shougang and the Shanghai Disneytown Journey to the West venue illustrate large-scale delivery and operations.
strength.zh: 首钢一高炉与上海迪士尼小镇西游体验，展示了大型项目的交付与运营能力。

limit.en: Venue operations are central; a small story prototype does not need this overhead.
limit.zh: 场馆是模式核心；轻量叙事原型不必先背负这套运营成本。

funding.en: 2023 Series C: several hundred million yuan per Lenovo Capital. New strategic financing reported in 2026; amount undisclosed.
funding.zh: 据联想创投，2023 年 C 轮数亿元人民币；2026 年另有战略融资报道，金额未披露。

alt.en: SoReal project image from Lenovo Capital
alt.zh: 联想创投发布的 SoReal 项目图

label.en: SoReal cases at Shougang and Disneytown
label.zh: 首钢与迪士尼小镇案例

advantage.en: Pairs real venues and physical effects with digital scenes.
advantage.zh: 把实体场馆、体感装置和虚拟场景结合。

blurb.en: Makes and distributes immersive films, online and in Zero Space venues.
blurb.zh: 制作、联合出品并发行 VR 影视，也经营「零号空间」。

strength.en: VeeR Studio works with external IP and combines VR production with a distribution channel.
strength.zh: 自有工作室对接外部 IP，把 VR 制作和发行通道结合在一起。

limit.en: Distribution does not establish live AI characters or audience-driven branches.
limit.zh: 有发行能力，不代表已经验证实时 AI 角色或开放式剧情。

funding.en: Shanghai Fengyuzhu's strategic investment is confirmed; amount not disclosed.
funding.zh: 确认获风语筑战略投资，金额未披露。

alt.en: VeeR company visual from Qiming Venture Partners
alt.zh: 启明创投发布的 VeeR 相关视觉

label.en: Qiming on the studio and Zero Space
label.zh: 启明创投：工作室与零号空间

advantage.en: Connects curated immersive work with exhibition access.
advantage.zh: 把沉浸作品的策展、发行和线下观看串起来。

blurb.en: A technology layer for characters that can talk back.
blurb.zh: 让角色能开口回应的底层技术。

strength.en: The investor's original character-engine case and today's voice products show two different pieces of the workflow.
strength.zh: 早期的角色引擎和现在的语音产品，解决的是工作流中的不同环节。

limit.en: It does not design narrative rules, character arcs or shared world memory for you.
limit.zh: 不替创作者设计叙事规则、人物弧线或观众共享的世界记忆。

funding.en: Company reports over US$125M raised cumulatively. A 2023 round of more than US$50M is included, not additional.
funding.zh: 公司披露累计融资超 1.25 亿美元；已包含 2023 年的超 5000 万美元一轮。

alt.zh: Inworld 实时语音产品视觉

advantage.en: Supplies a dialogue layer for characters inside larger worlds.
advantage.zh: 给已有世界加入可实时对话的角色能力。

blurb.en: Marble and Atlas build spatial settings; a setting is not yet a story.
blurb.zh: Marble 与 Atlas 能做空间，但空间本身还不是故事。

strength.en: Useful for worldbuilding, camera exploration and reconstructing environments from images. AMD closed the acquisition in November 2026.
strength.zh: 可用于世界观搭建、探索机位和从图像重建空间。AMD 于 2026 年 11 月完成收购。

limit.en: Character behaviour and plot still need authoring. Marble is scheduled to close on January 8, 2027.
limit.zh: 角色和情节仍需创作。Marble 公告将于 2027 年 1 月 8 日停服。

funding.en: About US$1.23B across the 2024 reported US$230M and 2026 company-announced US$1B. AMD's announced US$8.2B acquisition price is not funding.
funding.zh: 2024 年报道 2.3 亿美元，2026 年官宣 10 亿美元，合计约 12.3 亿美元；AMD 公告的约 82 亿美元收购价不是融资。

alt.en: Frameboy: Atlas in real-time — official example
alt.zh: 《Frameboy》Atlas 实时示例

label.en: World Labs: US$1 billion financing in 2026
label.zh: World Labs：2026 年 10 亿美元融资

label.en: TechCrunch: historical funding and the 2026 round
label.zh: TechCrunch：早期融资与 2026 年融资

advantage.en: Speeds up the creation of places that can be explored.
advantage.zh: 更快搭出观众能进入和探索的三维空间。

blurb.en: Builds simulations that change as you act inside them.
blurb.zh: 让数字环境随着人的输入实时变化。

strength.en: Good reference for testing an environment that responds to audience actions in real time.
strength.zh: 适合研究观众的动作如何改变眼前发生的事。

limit.en: Not a finished narrative engine for dramatic beats, editorial control or persistent shared stories.
limit.zh: 不是能直接交付故事节奏、导演控制或多人共享剧情的叙事系统。

funding.en: US$310M Series B in June 2026. US$1.45B was the valuation, not funding.
funding.zh: 2026 年 6 月 B 轮 3.1 亿美元；14.5 亿美元是估值，不是募资。

alt.zh: Odyssey 世界模拟官方视觉

advantage.en: Makes generated scenes respond as the viewer moves.
advantage.zh: 让生成画面随探索动作实时变化。

blurb.en: Space Explorers made the viewer feel physically present in orbit.
blurb.zh: 《Space Explorers》让观众感觉自己真的身处轨道。

strength.en: Cinematic depth, spatial sound and staging show how presence can carry a story even without branches.
strength.zh: 用空间声音、景深和场面调度证明：没有剧情分支，也可以靠临场感讲故事。

limit.en: The original entity filed for bankruptcy in September 2026. Treat rights and commissioning status as unverified.
limit.zh: 原公司 2026 年 9 月申报破产。作品权利与可合作主体需另行确认。

funding.en: US$6.8M Series A in 2016; not a current funding or operating claim.
funding.zh: 2016 年 A 轮约 680 万美元，不代表当前融资或运营状态。

alt.zh: 《Space Explorers》官方项目视觉

label.zh: 洛杉矶时报：2016 年 A 轮

advantage.en: Places the viewer beside real people in hard-to-access spaces.
advantage.zh: 以立体实拍把观众放到罕见现场和真人身边。

focus.en: Social VR and shifts of scale
focus.zh: 社交 VR / 尺度变化

blurb.en: Mormoverse turns the space under a pillow into a shared world worth exploring.
blurb.zh: 《Mormoverse》把枕头底下变成观众可以结伴探索的世界。

advantage.en: Shared discovery through changes of scale.
advantage.zh: 让熟悉的物件变成可结伴探索的新地标。

strength.en: Familiar furniture becomes a landmark at a new scale. Multiple visitors can explore it together, making each discovery a social event.
strength.zh: 把家具变成巨型地标，观众可以分享彼此找到的路径；空间本身在推动交流。

limit.en: A VRChat production with creative lead Film XR, not proof of independent multi-platform distribution.
limit.zh: 项目与创意主导方 Film XR 合作，依赖 VRChat；未验证独立多平台发行。

funding.en: Company funding amount not verified.
funding.zh: 未核实独立融资金额。

alt.zh: Worldbuild 项目剧照

place.zh: 哥伦比亚公司；作品为跨国合制

focus.zh: 口述故事转为空间体验

blurb.en: Origen draws on Amazonian oral traditions in an immersive work credited as a cross-border co-production.
blurb.zh: 《Origen》是以亚马孙口述传统为起点的跨国沉浸作品。

advantage.en: Turns oral traditions into a place you can enter.
advantage.zh: 把口述传统转译成观众能进入的空间。

strength.en: Turns research and collaboration with Indigenous cultural practitioners into point of view, place and encounter.
strength.zh: 把文化研究与原住民创作者的合作，落实为观众的视角、环境和遭遇。

limit.en: Venice lists the work under Brazil; Figitlab is a Colombian co-producer. Festival exhibition is not commercial rollout.
limit.zh: 威尼斯把作品列在巴西；Figitlab 是哥伦比亚联合制作方。影展展映不等于商业铺开。

funding.en: Unity for Humanity was a project grant; no company round amount verified.
funding.zh: Unity for Humanity 为项目资助，未核实公司融资金额。

alt.zh: Figitlab / Viartualmente 项目剧照

image.credit: La Biennale di Venezia / Origen production

focus.zh: 走入式 AR 历史叙事

blurb.en: Colored stages Claudette Colvin’s refusal to give up her seat on a segregated bus.
blurb.zh: 《Colored》重现克劳黛特·科尔文拒绝在实施种族隔离的公交车上让座的故事。

advantage.en: Life-size blocking makes the viewer a witness.
advantage.zh: 用真人尺度的调度，让观众站在故事现场。

strength.en: Life-size AR staging gives the viewer a physical position in the historical scene, turning proximity and blocking into narrative decisions.
strength.zh: 真人尺度的 AR 让观众在历史现场有一个明确的位置，距离、站位和调度都成为叙事手段。

limit.en: A facilitated exhibition format; a Cannes award does not establish mass-market sales.
limit.zh: 依赖现场布展和运营；戛纳获奖不代表已有大规模消费市场。

funding.en: No verified stand-alone company round for this collaboration.
funding.zh: 未核实这项合作对应的独立公司融资。

alt.zh: Flash Forward × Novaya 项目剧照

blurb.en: A Leap in Time uses the historic Saudi village of Zee Ain as the set.
blurb.zh: 《A Leap in Time》直接把沙特的历史村落 Zee Ain 变成演出现场。

advantage.en: Uses walking routes, architecture and live actors without headsets.
advantage.zh: 不用头显，用观众动线、建筑和真人表演讲故事。

strength.en: Audience routes and live performances let existing architecture do the work of a set and shape when a scene is revealed.
strength.zh: 让现有建筑承担布景和叙事功能，观众沿路线移动，新的场景才被揭开。

limit.en: Site-specific design and live cast add operating costs and limit plug-and-play touring.
limit.zh: 依赖地点和真人演员，有运营成本，不易原样复制巡展。

funding.en: Company finance not verified.
funding.zh: 未核实公司公开融资金额。

alt.zh: Maze of Tales 项目剧照

blurb.en: Mirage uses spatial sound, gestures and a haptic vest to portray a girl’s inner world.
blurb.zh: 《Mirage》用空间声音、手势和触觉背心呈现一个女孩的内心。

advantage.en: Uses touch and sound to convey a change in point of view.
advantage.zh: 用触觉和声音表现主观视角的变化。

strength.en: Hand tracking, spatial audio and tactile feedback make changes in the character’s mental state part of the sensory design rather than an explanation in dialogue.
strength.zh: 把角色心理变化做成手势、空间声音与触觉反馈，不只依靠对白解释。

limit.en: Cultural programme plus production partner, not a stand-alone company; equipment adds friction.
limit.zh: 这是文化机构计划与制作公司的合作，不是一家独立公司；设备增加部署成本。

funding.en: Project backing and company financing are not interchangeable; no round cited.
funding.zh: 项目支持不能算作公司融资，未引用独立融资轮次。

alt.zh: Ithra × Studio Biarritz 项目剧照

image.credit: La Biennale di Venezia / Mirage production

blurb.en: Edward Berger’s Submerged puts viewers inside a submarine during an attack.
blurb.zh: Edward Berger 的《Submerged》让观众置身遭袭的潜艇。

advantage.en: Staging, gaze and spatial sound make the viewer feel present.
advantage.zh: 用表演走位、视线和空间音频，把观众放进戏里。

strength.en: The physical set and stereo immersive framing put action at different depths; lighting, actor movement and spatial audio cue where to look without traditional shot coverage doing all the work.
strength.zh: 实体潜艇布景和立体画面把动作放在不同距离，灯光、演员走位和空间音频一起引导注意力。

limit.en: Authored, non-branching film. The original immersive viewing experience requires Apple Vision Pro.
limit.zh: 是导演安排的线性成片，不是分支交互；完整沉浸版需 Apple Vision Pro。

funding.en: Apple format and commissioned production, not an independent venture round.
funding.zh: 是苹果的内容格式与委托制作，不是独立公司的融资轮次。

alt.zh: Apple Immersive Video 项目剧照

focus.zh: VR 多人空间中的真人戏剧

blurb.en: The Under Presents and Tempest bring audiences into performances led by live actors.
blurb.zh: 《The Under Presents》和《Tempest》把观众带进由真人演员引导的 VR 演出。

advantage.en: Makes live improvisation part of the shared virtual world.
advantage.zh: 让演员即兴和观众回应都进入同一个虚拟世界。

strength.en: Live actors can adjust to audience reactions in real time; movement and shared presence distinguish each performance.
strength.zh: 真人演员能现场回应观众；走位、即兴表演和同场观众让每次演出有差异。

limit.en: Staffed live runs do not scale the same way as prerecorded games; current showtimes not assumed.
limit.zh: 真人演出不能像预录游戏一样扩张；不假定目前仍有场次。

funding.en: No verified public venture round.
funding.zh: 未核实公开股权融资轮次。

alt.zh: Tender Claws 项目剧照

focus.zh: 沉浸纪录／空间数字孪生

blurb.en: ecosphere takes viewers to habitats from Kenya’s savannahs to underwater reefs.
blurb.zh: 《ecosphere》让观众进入肯尼亚草原和海底珊瑚礁等自然环境。

advantage.en: Uses real locations and proximity to tell documentary stories.
advantage.zh: 用真实地点和镜头距离建立纪录片的在场感。

strength.en: Puts real environments at the centre of the experience; its digital twin and XR work offers distinct approaches to giving a location a point of view.
strength.zh: 让真实环境成为体验中心；结合纪录片与数字孪生实践，提供不同的空间表达方法。

limit.en: ecosphere is immersive documentary, not a branching AI story.
limit.zh: 《ecosphere》是沉浸纪录，不是生成式或分支叙事。

funding.en: No stand-alone studio-round amount verified for this entry.
funding.zh: 本条未核实工作室独立融资额。

alt.zh: PHORIA 项目剧照

focus.en: Spatial layers anchored to real venues
focus.zh: 给真实地点叠加叙事层

blurb.en: Ghost in the Shell: Cyber Vision put an AR layer into a physical exhibition with KDDI and XREAL.
blurb.zh: 与 KDDI、XREAL 合作，让《攻壳机动队》展的观众透过 AR 眼镜看见与展场叠加的内容。

advantage.en: Builds narrative overlays into a real venue’s route.
advantage.zh: 能把虚拟信息跟真实展览动线结合。

strength.en: Its authoring and delivery layer makes on-site AR stories possible without replacing the physical exhibit. A venue can make where you stand matter.
strength.zh: 提供空间创作和分发工具，保留原来的展品，也能让观众的位置影响看到的内容。

limit.en: An enabling platform and production partner; specific venue calibration and hardware are still necessary.
limit.zh: 它是技术平台及制作合作方；具体项目仍要做场地校准和设备部署。

funding.en: No funding figure cited for this project.
funding.zh: 本项目未引用单独融资金额。

alt.zh: STYLY 项目剧照

title.en: 100 venues in 13 countries; $300M in lifetime sales
title.zh: 13 国、100 家场馆，累计销售额 3 亿美元

summary.en: Evidence of paid demand for multiplayer outings at scale; the reported total is not annual revenue or profit.
summary.zh: 证明多人线下体验有付费需求；累计销售不是年度营收，更不是利润。

title.zh: Reality Labs 全年经营亏损预期 180–190 亿美元

summary.en: A platform-cost signal, not the size or profitability of the storytelling market.
summary.zh: 说明平台投入和经营压力，不是空间叙事市场规模或盈利数据。

title.en: Felix & Paul Studios entered Canadian bankruptcy proceedings
title.zh: Felix & Paul Studios 进入加拿大破产程序

summary.en: Acclaimed commissions and awards do not guarantee an economically sustainable studio.
summary.zh: 作品获奖、拿到大项目，不等于工作室的经营可以持续。

title.zh: 威尼斯沉浸单元：26 国、68 个项目

summary.en: The international creative field is already crowded; the selection size does not tell us ticket demand.
summary.zh: 全球创作端已有不少参与者；入选规模不能推算票房。

source.en: Journal of Hospitality and Tourism Management

title.zh: 自由行走式 VR 的四种体验能力

summary.en: An empirical study distinguishes story, gameplay, free movement and embodied interaction. It doesn't estimate market size.
summary.zh: 研究归纳了叙事、游戏、自由移动和身体互动，适合做体验设计参考，不是市场测算。

title.en: How independent immersive work reaches audiences
title.zh: 独立沉浸作品怎样找到观众

summary.en: Looks at community-led distribution; finishing a work and getting it booked are different problems.
summary.zh: 讨论由社区推动的发行模式：做完一部作品，和让它进入场馆及社区，是两件事。

title.en: DiaryPlay: AI characters inside author-set boundaries
title.zh: DiaryPlay：让 AI 角色在作者设定的边界内变化

summary.en: Tests player-driven divergence without giving up authored story constraints. A prototyping precedent, not evidence of willingness to pay.
summary.zh: 展示玩家行为如何让叙事分岔，同时保留创作者设定的范围；是原型参考，不是付费证据。

title.en: A venue reports over 2.5M global visitors for Horizon of Khufu
title.zh: 场馆称《胡夫地平线》全球观众超过 250 万

summary.en: A cultural story can tour internationally; the venue statement does not disclose per-site profitability.
summary.zh: 文化题材可以跨城市巡展；公告没有披露单馆的营收成本或利润率。

title.zh: 爱奇艺在扬州开出首座爱奇艺乐园

summary.en: Screen IP is moving to physical experiences in China, too; the park is broader than pure XR.
summary.zh: 中国也在把影视 IP 转成线下体验，但整座乐园不能等同于纯 XR 市场。
